title: Voice line generation behavior
description:
## Behavior
```gherkin
Feature: Generate spoken voice samples with Auritus

  Scenario: Generate a voice line into the library
    Given an empty library
    When I generate voice line "intro" saying "Welcome to the show." with voice "kokoro:af_heart"
    Then the library has a sample with role "generated" and alias "voice/intro.wav"
    And its generator records engine "auritus", the backend, model, voice, text and request key
    And the sample has analysis and phrase markers

  Scenario: Regenerating the same request is a no-op
    Given voice line "intro" was generated saying "Welcome to the show." with voice "kokoro:af_heart"
    When I generate the same voice line again
    Then no new audio is synthesized
    And the library still has exactly one sample for it

  Scenario: A different request makes a new sample
    Given voice line "intro" was generated saying "Welcome to the show." with voice "kokoro:af_heart"
    When I generate voice line "intro" saying "Welcome back." with voice "kokoro:af_heart"
    Then the alias "voice/intro.wav" points at the new sample

  Scenario: A score plays a generated voice line as recorded
    Given voice line "intro" was generated
    When I compile a score with "clip intro = voice/intro.wav warp repitch" from the library
    Then the intro track plays unwarped for the line's full duration

  Scenario: Missing speech engine fails loudly
    Given the voice extra is not installed
    When I generate voice line "intro"
    Then the command fails and says to install "apricity-analyze[voice]"
```
